Sparsh is a sensational story of Anirudh Parmar (Naseeruddin Shah) who is blind. Yet his impairment does not let him down. He starts a school for the blind as a Principal. During his days he gets in touch with a social worker, Kavita. Kavita is attracted to him, and he slowly also gets attracted to her. When marriage is proposed, both agree to marry each other. Then Anirudh starts having doubts whether this marriage is going to succeed. How will Kavita ensure Anirudh that their married life would be successful?
